title: Drawer: a [hidden] bug, not a missing cap — scroll and footer fixed

set.card: Drawer: tight header, one scroll area, footer at the bottom
set.outcome:
**Fixed.** Root cause: the closed session-switcher list rendered at ~940px because its `.flex` class beat `[hidden]` — it pushed the composer off-screen and forced the whole body to scroll.

- [x] header hugs, body is the ONLY scroll box, footer stays put via flex-grow: proved live — scrolling a real 4000px thread leaves header/footer rects unchanged (after-1920-thread-top.png, after-1920-thread-bottom.png)
- [x] footer full width, flush, `--wash`, one `var(--pad)`, no border: after-1920-drawer.png vs before-3440-drawer.png
- [x] unknown space killed: the switcher's phantom 940px block is gone (`.drawer-ai-switch-list[hidden]` now `!important`)
- [x] screenshots at 400/1200/1920/3440: after-400/1200/1920/3440-drawer.png — nothing overlaps

reviewed: pass (size none — single-file root-cause fix, proven by probe). Doc: [decisions.md](/framework/ext/drawer/doc/decisions/).
